unit.why: This is an exegesis of the phrase 'איש סחו אחריו ד׳ הוא אלקים'. It contrasts talk of Elijah's miracle with the divine revelation that made people forget the miracle, and it has no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Appears to continue the exegetical material of the previous division, which ends mid-discourse. The next division begins a new anecdote (פ"א שלח לו עשיר אחד).
